name: Rapa Nui (Easter Island)
members: Non-residents (including Chileans) are limited to a 30-day stay and must show an entry form, return ticket and accommodation.

name: Guilin ASEAN tour-group visa waiver
members: ASEAN tour groups may stay 6 days visa-free in Guilin only, entering via Guilin airport.

name: Hainan Province
members: Nationals of 59 countries may enter Hainan visa-free for 30 days and must stay within the province; foreign tour groups from HK/Macau get 144 h in Hainan.

name: Tibet Autonomous Region
members: Foreigners need a Tibet Travel Permit, checked on boarding transport to Tibet.

name: Xishuangbanna ASEAN tour-group visa waiver
members: ASEAN tour groups may stay 6 days visa-free in Xishuangbanna only.

name: Archipelago of San Andrés, Providencia and Santa Catalina
members: Every non-resident, Colombians included, needs an OCCRE tourist card to enter; tourist stay is capped at 4 months per year.

name: Galápagos Province
members: All visitors must obtain a Transit Control Card (TCT); tourist stay is capped (60 days per year per earlier sample).

name: Clipperton Island
members: Landing and stay need prior authorisation of the High Commissioner in French Polynesia / overseas minister (Décret 2023-1182; arrêté of 2025-11-03).

name: Mount Athos
members: Entry needs a special permit (diamonitirion); women are not admitted.

name: Arunachal Pradesh
members: Foreigners need a Protected Area Permit for the whole state; non-resident Indians need an Inner Line Permit.

name: Sikkim
members: Whole state is partly Protected and partly Restricted Area; foreigners need a permit.

name: Jeju Province
members: Most ordinary-passport holders otherwise needing a Korean visa may stay 30 days visa-free in Jeju Province only, arriving on direct international flights to Jeju.

name: Transnistria
members: Own checkpoints issue a migration card (45 days); since 2023-04-01 Ukrainian men 18-60 need MGB permission.

name: Mexico southern border states (Regional Visitor Card)
members: Nationals/permanent residents of Guatemala, Belize, El Salvador and Honduras may visit Campeche, Chiapas, Tabasco, Quintana Roo and Yucatán for up to 7 days per entry on a TVR, without a visa; not valid elsewhere.

name: Sabah
members: Separate state immigration control: arrivals from Peninsular Malaysia, including Malaysians, pass immigration and get a separate stay permission.

name: Sarawak
members: Separate state immigration control with its own stay permission, also for Malaysians from other states.

name: Chukotka Autonomous Okrug
members: The okrug is a 'territory with regulated entry for foreign visitors': foreigners need an FSB-coordinated authorisation plus a border-zone pass.

name: Ascension Island
members: All nationalities, British citizens included, need an Ascension e-visa in advance; no visa on arrival; several nationalities not issued visas.

name: Tristan da Cunha
members: All visitors need prior approval of the Administrator / Island Council to land.

name: Puntland
members: Puntland rejects the federal e-visa (Sept 2025) and charges its own USD 60 visa on arrival; launched own visa system Nov 2025.

name: Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Oblast (GBAO)
members: All foreigners need a separate GBAO permit (via e-visa or OVIR) in addition to visa/visa-free entry; checked at oblast checkpoints.

name: Kinmen County
members: PRC nationals may get a 15-day entry permit on arrival if they stay only in Kinmen/Matsu/Penghu and arrive by boat at listed ports.

name: Lienchiang County (Matsu)
members: Same permit on arrival, valid only for the offshore counties.

name: Zanzibar
members: Own immigration checks on arrival from the mainland; since 2024-10-01 all visitors must buy Zanzibar-specific travel insurance.

name: Phu Quoc Island
members: All foreign visitors arriving directly from abroad may stay 30 days visa-free if they remain on Phu Quoc.

name: Socotra Archipelago
members: Tourists enter on a Socotra-only visa issued by the Socotra immigration office via a local sponsor (flights from Abu Dhabi); it is not valid for mainland Yemen.
